result.finding: Background Service / Message Producer. The application is a Spring Boot standalone program that runs once, sends 10 messages to Azure Service Bus queues, and terminates. It has no REST controllers, no web endpoints, and no recurring scheduler — it is a one-shot message producer invoked from main().
evidence: Main class calls SpringApplication.run() then immediately invokes producer.run() and exits
Producer.run() sends 10 messages across queue1 and queue2 via ServiceBusTemplate then returns
No @RestController, @Controller, @RequestMapping, or web MVC annotations found
No HTTP server port configured in application.properties
Dependencies: spring-cloud-azure-starter + spring-messaging-azure-servicebus (messaging only, no web starter)
README describes it as a project that sends messages to a message broker
